question: Is OpenWeather for agents (agents.openweathermap.org and data.openweathermap.org) a separate free offer that needs its own record?
why: Its guide says a signup is one POST with an email, 'No password. No email confirmation. No browser.', and that One Call gives every account 1,000 credits a day, replaced each night, with 'No card, no verification, no human step'; other feeds are paid from the first call. The guide names its operator as Extreme Electronics Ltd, trading as The Bot Forum, under common ownership with OpenWeather. No record covers it, and data-apis/openweather describes One Call 3.0 as opened through a billing form. A discover unit should read the guide and the Terms and probe data.openweathermap.org with no key; no account was created.
